turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I keep picking up my phone every five minutes when I study. It's pathetic.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's not pathetic, phones are designed for that. Would you rather put it in another room, or keep it nearby with an app that blocks everything?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me a minute, my friend just walked in. Don't say anything until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Omar, why are you putting the fancy cereal in the trolley again?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Because the cheap one tastes like cardboard.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's literally the same flakes in a different box.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It is not. The store one goes soggy in about ten seconds.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine, but then you're eating it dry next week when we're broke.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Deal. Can we at least get the big box so it's less per bowl?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm back now. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, are we banishing the phone or locking it down?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The app. I need it for my lecture slides.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Makes sense. Block everything except the slides app, and turn notifications off.
